note: Proposed (not-shipped) contract shape per docs/design/design-pipeline.md §2 S3 and the design-block-spec skill. No klt verb emits this. This is the spec S4 selects a topology against.

output_dc_valid_v.note: output stays in a legal high-gain operating band at the balanced operating point

interface.inp: non-inverting input (reference node in the buffer application)
interface.inn: inverting input (tied to out in the unity-gain application; driven differentially here for open-loop characterization)
interface.ibias_in: tail bias current input from bias_gen (nominal 20 uA)

input_common_mode_v.note: mid-rail; adequate headroom for an NMOS input pair over an NMOS tail at 1.62 V worst-case supply

area_power_ceiling.area: deferred to S4/S7 layout judgment (no area-ceiling number encoded at block spec; the topology is a five-device core plus a one-device on-block bias replica)

deferred_to_s4: device count / topology family (single-stage vs cascoded vs two-stage) -- S4's judgment against gain/power/PM
exit_check: Every field S4 needs (electrical targets, PVT range, input CM, load, device class) is present or explicitly deferred to S4. Corner matrix (5 process x 2 supply x 2 temp) is declared, closing the S3 'spec narrower than KB match' failure mode.
